answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via max-flow trust graphs. Verified nodes sign capacity-capped endorsements, and admission requires sufficient flow from trusted seeds, blocking a tide of self-attesting clones. Because honest edges bound flow, attackers must earn scarce endorsements or compromise existing accounts per identity instead of flooding a cold tundra of keys. However, admission becomes rare as a lotus for unlinked newcomers, and adversaries can still buy aged accounts.
